Ken은 항상 텍사스를 위해 일해 왔으며 미국 상원에서도 계속 그렇게 할 진정한 MAGA 전사입니다. 그의 상대인 James TalaFREAKO는 팁에 대한 세금 없음, 초과 근무에 대한 세금 없음, 사회 보장에 대한 세금 없음에 반대하는 급진 좌파 민주당원입니다. 만약 그와 민주당이 개입한다면 이 모든 것이 종료될 것입니다. 그는 대규모 세금 인상, 국경 개방, 여성 부문에서 남성 경기를 원합니다.

I know Ken well, have seen him tested at the highest and most difficult levels, and he is a WINNER! Ken is a true MAGA Warrior who has ALWAYS delivered for Texas, and will continue to do so in the United States Senate. His opponent, James TalaFREAKO, is a Radical Left Democrat who is opposed to NO TAX ON TIPS, NO TAX ON OVERTIME, and NO TAX ON SOCIAL SECURITY and, if he and the Dumocrats ever got in, all of these things will be terminated. He wants massive Tax Increases, Open Borders, Men playing in Women’s Sports, and Transgender Mutilization of your Children. James TalaFREAKO is Reckless, Radical, and Dangerous! On the other hand, as your next Senator, Ken will tirelessly fight to continue the Great Growth of our Economy, Cut Taxes and Regulations, Advance MADE IN THE U.S.A., Unleash American Energy DOMINANCE, Champion Texas Oil & Gas, Advocate for our Amazing Farmers and Ranchers, Promote School Choice, Keep our Border SECURE, Stop Migrant Crime, Support our Incredible Military/Veterans, Safeguard our Elections, and Protect our always under siege Second Amendment. Ken Paxton has my Complete and Total Endorsement to be the next United States Senator from the Great State of Texas. GET OUT AND VOTE FOR KEN — HE WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN! President DONALD J. TRUMP
